notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.9c
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a tool to create profiles in the character selection menu when playing in local multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed a short loss of control with pad at the end of a local multiplayer game in tournament mode when choosing to "resume" instead of restarting or changing the game mode.
[*] Fixed a loss of control when entering the main menu of the game until the mouse interact for the 1st time.
[*] Fixed visual artifacts from some screen ratio. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.9a
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The in-game crown displaying the leading team by combining score was faulty in various team configurations.
[*] Fixed multiple visual glitches in the multiplayer level selection, added color highlight based on player selection in tournament modes.
[*] From now on, the game version will be displayed with a warning sign in the character selection when joining online multiplayer session if conflicting versions are used between clients and server.
[*] Tutorial has been soften and does not need to be completed to continue the adventure.
[*] The ambulance in local multiplayer display the player number on top of it, and in online multiplayer only display an arrow to indicate yourself for better readability.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this post is very important for us, because it is the last levels of CIBOS. So there are 3 new levels playable in multi-online/Local.

[list]
[*] Burning bolt : you have 5 lives, to win, it's very simple, you will have to push your opponents in the flames.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/987726cfdbbedaee49aee5a81c62d2971fddba59.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/508bf0716146772d1eed86ee465b5e78f373f5ad.gif[/img]
[*] Opposing gravity: defy gravity in an arena of varying geographies and blast your opponents out of the gravity zone to electrocute them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/2fa372fe222b56a1788eb761f1d56567c3cc2e03.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/7f22b29786e4929f98039c1c3e7f9e796ca08989.gif[/img]
[*] Traffic Jam : You are on a highway of ships where you will have to steal bolts while being careful not to get knocked down, burned or dashed by your opponents. This last level is the most difficult one, so don't venture there if you don't have any skill!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/c79b957fb7521af84d7462390c323d3f3df48a07.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/7fadff76a5617b2876af270097354e06be6a81ad.gif[/img]
[*] Finally, discover the different game modes available for the online/local multiplayer game.
[/list]

Don't hesitate to give us feedback!

tags.feature: So there are 3 new levels playable in multi-online/Local.
Burning bolt : you have 5 lives, to win, it's very simple, you will have to push your opponents in the flames.
Opposing gravity: defy gravity in an arena of varying geographies and blast your opponents out of the gravity zone to electrocute them.

Traffic Jam : You are on a highway of ships where you will have to steal bolts while being careful not to get knocked down, burned or dashed by your opponents. This last level is the most difficult one, so don't venture there if you don't have any skill!
Finally, discover the different game modes available for the online/local multiplayer game.

notes.title: Mid Early Access Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32153182/5112c19e7c7ea36b823df4782ac5476b4839d284.jpg[/img]

Greetings dear Cibos, It’s time for our mid Early Acces update about CIBOS on Steam.

It’s already been 4 month since the release of CIBOS, and we have just released our 5th updates bringing even more new levels and challenges. It’s why it’s maybe time for a little summary about our last features:

Climb up the pyramid scheme, dash your friends into fire or steal them bolts… Become the best employee over the galaxy whatever it takes!!!

[b]The smelting plant fighting arena[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NVF58AI.gif[/img]

The smelting plant is ready to welcome its new employee, but who will remain until the end? Up to 4 players, dash all your opponent into the fire to win this round.
[b]
The Thunder Wheel is spinning
[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uhMlZ5y.gif[/img]


Hit at the right time the green piston or feel the the vengeful striking hammer of the wheel if you touch the red one.

[b]The Bolt reactor[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M3tr1Kw.gif[/img]

The Bolt reactor has arrived: Up to 4 players Online and Local, compete and collect bolts before the hoovers steal them.

[b]The Bolt Box[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jzeAbCU.gif[/img]


Everyone has “The Boss” bonus, so you can’t be dashed or lose bolts. Your only goal is to collect as much bolts as you can in the limited time: Be quick or you’re fired!!

[b]Boss of the pyramid scheme
[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f1R77tV.gif[/img]

Based on the “king of the hill” party game mode, we are presenting you the pyramid scheme!!!
You have one goal, the CIBOS on the top of the pyramid collect all the bolts and the others has to eject him to take his place.

However if you touch the laser, you have to climb the pyramid from the bottom

[b]Early Access[/b]

We have prepair just for you a roadmap for the future update of CIBOS during the Early Access.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1TsWqOV.jpg[/img]

We will update this map and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/728090/discussions/0/3362406825536839132/]Steam thread[/url] in order to keep you updated about the new features and levels that we will implement during the Early Access of CIBOS.

Stay tuned, we will back soon with more new levels!!!

notes.title: Update 0.1.1 : Boss of the pyramid scheme and Early Access roadmap
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/omV1HNq.jpg[/img]

Greetings dear Cibos, It’s time for the first update of CIBOS on Steam, and we are bringing you a brand new level with a special mode.

Are you ready to dash your opponent, collect power-up and bolts to become the best employee of the galaxy!!!



[url=http://eepurl.com/cmfymf] Subscribe here [/url] if you want to receive our Early Access news directly to your mailbox.


[h1]Boss of the pyramid scheme is now available: [/h1]


Based on the “king of the hill” party game mode, we are presenting you the pyramid scheme!!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f1R77tV.gif[/img]

You have one goal, the CIBOS on the top of the pyramid collect all the bolts and the others has to eject him to take his place.

However if you touch the laser, you have to climb the pyramid from the bottom.

The pyramid scheme will assure you hours of fun and will probably wreck some friendship.

[b]Screenshots:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EOUuGni.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9lTVowt.jpg[/img]



[b]Early Access roadmap: [/b]

We've prepared just for you a roadmap for the future update of CIBOS during the Early Access.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CCWL9Ni.jpg[/img]

We will update this map and the Steam thread in order to keep you updated about the new features and levels that we will implement during the Early Access of CIBOS.


Stay tuned, we will back soon with more new levels!!!
